description: As of this week, the Texas primary runoffs are officially behind us. Consequently, the narrow legal window for independent candidates to collect signatures has blown wide open. To get Lisa’s name printed on the ballot this November, we must now gather 500 signatures from registered voters within District 126 who did not cast a ballot
title: The Race is On: The Runoffs Are Over and the Fight to get on the Ballot Begins - Lisa for TX 126
